svg.title: Lanka — Rain Gallery plan, elevation and transverse section
svg.desc: Three bays repeat along an open-sided walk. Count the bays to call a crossing above the salt road before Bell Pier. The plan is north up, uses metres, and locates two opposed thresholds.
svg.text: Lanka / map station 7, Rain Gallery / pillared hall
I (-30, 26) II (-16, 26) map X, Z in metres
Signal Court → Rain Gallery → Bell Pier
Three bays repeat along an open-sided walk. Count the bays to call a crossing
above the salt road before Bell Pier.
21.9 s dry / 21.9 s with optional routes
Both exits join ordinary dry routes.
Passage 6 m wide. Full-width headroom 2.35 m above the dry threshold.
Architectural reference L1 · Route-strip reference C1 · All dimensions are YUGA design values.
